abstract: Fine needle aspiration (FNA) was used to study nodules in the left breast of a patient with a previous history of uterine choriocarcinoma. The FNA smears contained numerous malignant mononucleated cells and multinucleated giant cells. The cytologic diagnosis was metastatic choriocarcinoma, which was confirmed by histologic study of excised tissue. That diagnosis would have been difficult to make cytologically if the previous history had not been known; the differential diagnosis of multinucleated giant cells in an aspirate from a breast mass is discussed.
abstract_ja: 穿刺吸引細胞診（FNA）を用いて、子宮絨毛癌の既往歴がある患者の左乳房結節を検討した。FNA塗抹標本には多数の悪性単核細胞と多核巨細胞が認められた。細胞学的診断は転移性絨毛癌であり、切除組織の組織学的検討により確認された。既往歴が知られていなければ細胞学的に診断することは困難であったと考えられ、乳腺腫瘤の穿刺吸引標本における多核巨細胞の鑑別診断について論じた。
